rows.en: Jono: "..."
Vel: "Huh, I thought we'd shaken them off completely...
They're pretty good."
Yamato: "Look! Those are the mercenaries' machines!
Oh, there are Zigrim military Armored Mechs, too!"
Touya: "Looks like we hit the mark."
Clovis: "...Be careful. Even for presidential security,
it's hard to imagine they'd keep Armored Mechs deployed all the time.
And this is firmly under Zigrim's control.
It's more natural to think they're ready for our approach."
Celica: "But we can't just start a battle out of nowhere.
It might be pointless, but let's try negotiating.
Miyasco, please."
Miyasco: "Understood. Opening a channel."
Horem: "I suppose I should say it's a pleasure to meet you."
Clovis: "Oh, the mastermind comes out in person."
Celica: "Mr. President..."
Horem: "Your Highness Princess Celica,
I trust you are well..."
Celica: "We can skip the pleasantries.
I'll get straight to the point. Give Ymir back."
Horem: "...I'm afraid I can't do that.
But you've come all this way,
so I suppose I can't simply turn you away.
Very well. Shall we make a wager?"
Celica: "A wager?"
Horem: "Yes. As you can see, we have
the ≪Solitary Silver Wings≫
and my private guards here.
Fight them, and if you win, I'll return Ymir."
Celica: "...And if we lose?"
Horem: "Naturally, you will help me
with my plan. I hold all of you
in very high regard, after all."
Touya: "What the hell gives you the right to decide that?!"
Horem: "I believe I've offered you equal terms,
even so..."
Arthur: "That's true.
He could use Ymir as a hostage to force us to cooperate."
Horem: "Exactly. But rest assured.
Even if you win, I promise I won't resort
to anything so disgraceful."
Touya: "Like we can trust your word."
Aurelie: "For your kind, a public pledge is just talk.
You never meant to keep it in the first place, did you?"
Horem: "That's only true of low-minded political hacks.
They lack conviction."
Touya: "And you're saying you've got it?"
Horem: "More than Agarthia's politicians, at least."
Clovis: "...We'll have to accept his terms for now."
Maki: "If it comes to it, I could let the whole world
see this recording."
Celica: "That's our last resort.
For now, rescuing Ymir comes first.
...All right. We accept your proposal."
Horem: "Very good. Best of luck, then..."
Celica: "People call him an ineffectual figurehead...
But it seems he's quite a fox."
Touya: "What the hell is that Horem
guy thinking?"
Arthur: "For now, let's concentrate on what's in front of us."
Celica: "Let's go, everyone!"
Mechanic A: "Zeulear's repairs are finished."
Mechanic D: "Good luck!"
Touya: "Yeah, leave it to me!"
Yamato: "Touya! All systems green.
We're ready to launch."
Touya: "All right! Rayblade, moving out!"
Vales: "...So they've come out.
A head-on battle lacks finesse, but it can't be helped."
Vel: "It's part of the job."
Touya: "Are you all right now?"
Xiujian: "Yes."
Touya: "...I see."
Xiujian: "Sorry I worried you."
Touya: "Don't push yourself."
Xiujian: "Heh... You don't need to tell me."
Ai: "Touya. I'm doing things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but I'll be acting independently
this time."
Clovis: "I'll act on my own. I'm leaving your end to you."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I still can't put my life in your hands.
I'll do things my way."
Celica: "Sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Cain: "This is our first time meeting face to face."
Celica: "That voice... Is that you, Cain?!"
Cain: "Hello, Celica. It's been a while.
How is Tix?"
Celica: "Why are you in Zaxas...?"
Cain: "Well, why indeed?
You'll understand in time. In time.
Oh, and there's no point protesting to my country.
Officially, I no longer exist."
Celica: "What do you mean by that...?"
Cain: "I suppose I'm a tragic prince driven out of his country."
Celica: "Stop joking!"
Cain: "...Enough talk.
I have to fight you for my own sake.
Well, then... here I come!"
Miyasco: "It couldn't be... No, that's impossible.
There can't still be survivors... But that's remote-controlled..."
Sisk: "What's wrong? You're white as a sheet."
Miyasco: "I-I'm all right. Don't worry."
Cain: "Hello. We meet again."
Celica: "Cain! What's happened to you...?
Cain: "Isn't it about time you woke up?
The weakling Cain who had a fleeting crush on you is gone.
I've been reborn.
Besides, you never felt anything for me, did you?
Then there's no reason for you to care."
Celica: "How can you say that?! You vanished so suddenly...
Do you know how much it hurt Tix...?"
Cain: "Such beautiful love between sister and brother?
Well, fine. It has nothing to do with me now.
Enough talk.
Let me repay you for last time... Here I come."
Celica: "Cain!"
Cain: "Hello. It's been a while.
Sorry I've been too busy to say hello."
Touya: "You bastard... You've got some nerve..."
Cain: "What are you angry about?
...Oh, that chancellor?
Heh heh heh. That wasn't me.
It was what he himself wanted deep down.
I just drew it out a little for him.
I told him to be more honest with himself."
Touya: "You bastard..."
Celica: "Touya! Don't give in to your anger!
It'll be dangerous if Burst Prana happens again!"
Touya: "...I know. I'm not going to stay some kid
who can't control his feelings forever."
Cain: "Alforina was fated to die anyway.
When the castle fell. It was only delayed a little."
Ai: "Heh heh heh..."
Touya: "A-Ai?!"
Ai: "Who the hell do you think you are? I don't know why you're acting
so damn smug, but what you're doing is even lower than politicians who cling
to money and status without dirtying their own hands.
Even if it's a lie, they put up a respectable front.
You don't even have that.
You're just a brat who does whatever he wants!"
Cain: "Oh... Come to think of it, you were close to Alforina,
weren't you? I understand that anger.
I've felt something very similar myself.
Heh heh heh. Fine. Hate me if you want.
If it will clear your heart.
That's what I'm acting for myself, after all..."
Ai: "Yes. I won't forgive you. But this isn't revenge.
It's so there won't be anyone else like me."
Cain: "Hmph... Dress it up however you like, it comes to the same thing.
People aren't so wise that they can put their feelings aside
that easily.
Well... enough talk... Here I come."
Fain: "How do you know about my master?!"
Vales: "Heh..."
Fain: "You couldn't be..."
Vales: "I'm no one. Just a mercenary enthralled by battle.
Nothing more, nothing less..."
Fain: "What?! Those movements... Master...?"
Vales: "Oh, so you're the man who studies under Rest...
Heh heh heh. You move quite well..."
Fain: "You... No, you..."
Vales: "What's wrong? Show me what you can do.
Your master was better than that."
Cain: "Ghh... You're quite good...
Heh heh heh... Fine... It wouldn't be interesting otherwise..."
Horem: "That's enough."
Cain: "What?!"
Horem: "You've lost. Please withdraw."
Cain: "I haven't lost yet!"
Horem: "...Please withdraw."
Cain: "..."
Jono: "Spirit Mechs... Impressive, as expected."
Horem: "Thank you.
That's enough for today. Please withdraw."
Jono: "...Understood."
Vel: "Heh heh heh... This is fun...
It's been a while since I had an opponent with some bite..."
Horem: "I'm sorry to interrupt your fun,
but would you admit defeat for today?"
Vel: "...Is that an order from our client?"
Horem: "You may take it that way."
Vel: "Tch... All right."
Vales: "So that's it... We're retreating!"
